title: Scaffold Unity project and headless test pipeline
description: Create the Unity 6 project on disk with the packages and assembly structure every later ticket depends on, and prove it compiles and runs tests headlessly. Target the INSTALLED editor 6000.0.38f1 (Unity 6.0 LTS) — do not require a different editor download. Follow the unity-core and unity-testing skills.
acceptance_criteria: A Unity project exists (Assets/, ProjectSettings/, Packages/manifest.json) opened by editor 6000.0.38f1 without upgrade prompts.
Packages present in manifest: com.unity.inputsystem, com.unity.test-framework, com.unity.addressables.

Assembly definitions exist: Barcade.Core (pure C#, no UnityEngine-only deps where avoidable), Barcade.Framework (engine adapters, references Core), Barcade.Core.Tests (EditMode test asmdef referencing Core + nunit + test-framework, excluded from player builds).
Project compiles in Unity batchmode with zero errors.
One trivial EditMode smoke test runs via the documented Unity CLI headless command and the run exits 0.
A Unity-appropriate .gitignore is present and the repo is initialized with an initial commit.
